Official DSH 0.2.2-rc.1 compatibility update.

Support official DSH `0.2.2-rc.1` while retaining full compatibility with `0.2.1-rc.5`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, and `0.2.0-rc.2`. Add explicit `0.2.2-rc.1` admission to declared peerDependencies, engines, and root lock metadata, resolving npm `ERESOLVE` under default npm prerelease semantics. Identify standalone composer chips via native picker state (`anchorRef` and `selectedId`) rather than localized placeholder text matching, reliably maintaining standalone chip labeling and native aria attributes across all host locales (with English fallback outside Chinese, without claiming new translation catalogs) and avoiding collisions with real workspaces named "No Workspace", "Choose workspace", or "研究資料".

适配官方 DSH `0.2.2-rc.1`（同时保留 `0.2.1-rc.5`、`0.2.1-rc.2` 与 `0.2.0-rc.2` 完整兼容）。在 peerDependencies 和 engines 声明中显式纳入 `0.2.2-rc.1`，解决 npm 默认预发布语义下的 `ERESOLVE` 依赖解析限制。改用原生工作区选择器状态（`anchorRef` 与 `selectedId`）识别独立会话 composer 标识，取代对本地化占位符文本的脆弱匹配；在各宿主语言环境下准确呈现独立状态与原生 aria 属性（中文显示「无工作区」，非中文环境沿用英文兜底，不引入多语言词条功能扩展），并避免将名称恰好为「No Workspace」、「Choose workspace」或「研究資料」的真实工作区误判为独立会话。

Declared DSH range: `>=0.2.0-rc.2 <0.3.0-0 || 0.2.1-rc.2 || 0.2.1-rc.5 || 0.2.2-rc.1`. Keep version `1.1.0` on DSH 0.1.x.

Notes / Behavioral details:
- Official `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1` requires Node `>=24.9.0`. The plugin retains Node 22 compatibility for older hosts, introducing no global plugin Node floor breaking existing environments.
- Standalone composer chip detection hooks into native picker props, cleanly separating optimistic selection tracking from text nodes. Native aria-labels and labels are fully restored upon workspace attachment or plugin disposal.
- Real workspaces with names that coincide with standalone UI strings retain their native presentation and are never marked standalone.

注意 / 行为说明：
- 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.2.2-rc.1` 声明需要 Node `>=24.9.0`。插件本身在旧版宿主上继续保持 Node 22 兼容，不设全局高版本 Node 限制，避免影响既有运行环境。
- 独立会话 composer 标识通过原生选择器属性接入，将乐观选择追踪与文本节点正确解耦。在关联真实工作区或插件卸载时，完整恢复原生文本与 aria-label。
- 名称与独立状态标识重合的真实工作区保持原生呈现，绝不误标为独立会话。

Validation: 154 automated unit, robustness, persistence, and interaction tests (`npm test`), release-tool checks (`npm run check:release-tools`, 4 pass), trusted publishing tests (`scripts/npm-publish.test.mjs`, 10 pass), real npm archive verification (`npm run check:package`, 8 files), and isolated headless Edge browser acceptance across all four official DSH runtimes (`0.2.0-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.2`, `0.2.1-rc.5`, and `0.2.2-rc.1`) with actual host restart, durable session verification, multi-locale layout/reloading, guest browser profile isolation, and zero browser errors.

Install from a local checkout or packed archive (or from npm once `dsh-plugin-no-workspace@1.5.0` is published):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add ./dsh-plugin-no-workspace-1.5.0.tgz
```

Restart DSH after updating.
